newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos Pacific expects steady '97 growth.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos Pacific expects steady '97 growth.

text.p: Food-based Cerebos Pacific Ltd said on Monday it expects its core business to continue performing at satisfactory levels for 1997.
A Cerebos statement said this was likely barring any unforeseen circumstances and provided the difficult trading conditions in Australasia do not deteriorate further.
Trading conditions in the company's Australasia operations during the first-half of the year worsened, resulting in profits below last year, it said.
The company saw group revenues rise 11 percent in 1996 to Singapore $102.15 million for the 12 months ended September 30.
